finding.title: Split the six progress-feature files exceeding the 400-line hand-written Dart limit
finding.why: wc -l confirms: recent_activity_screen.dart 792 lines, lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart 657, siyumim_grouped_view.dart 437, progress_screen.dart 416, curriculum_breakdown_list.dart 413, monthly_activity_sliver_calendar.dart 404 — all over the 400-line hand-written-file cap, one nearly 2x. lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart in particular mixes DB access, composite-curriculum business logic, provenance computation and presentation-label resolution in one file, making it the hardest file in the slice to review or safely change.
finding.recommendation: Extract cohesive sub-responsibilities (e.g. split lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart's composite/subset-merging logic into its own service; split recent_activity_screen.dart's four chart-section widgets into their own files).
acceptance_criteria: Each listed file is at or under 400 lines, or the limit is deliberately waived with a stated reason
AG-3 line-count checker (once it exists) reports zero violators in lib/features/progress/presentation

finding.title: Route the hardcoded 'Curriculum settings' tooltip through AppLocalizations in curriculum_progress_screen.dart
finding.why: The settings-gear IconButton's tooltip is a raw English literal, not resolved via AppLocalizations/ARB, in an EN+Hebrew app. A Hebrew user long-pressing the icon or using a screen reader sees/hears untranslated English. None of curriculum_progress_screen_test.dart's 6 tests — including its two Hebrew-locale tests — assert against this tooltip, so the gap is invisible to the suite. (3 more hardcoded tooltip: literals exist elsewhere in the repo outside this batch's scope, not counted here.)
finding.recommendation: Add an ARB key (e.g. curriculumProgressSettingsTooltip) in both app_en.arb and app_he.arb and use l10n.curriculumProgressSettingsTooltip instead of the literal.
acceptance_criteria: tooltip: is sourced from AppLocalizations, not a string literal
make arb-parity still passes with the new key present in both EN and HE ARBs

finding.title: Give pace_indicator.dart, stage_breakdown_row.dart and hierarchy_progress_card.dart their own mirrored test files
finding.why: progress_widgets_test.dart has no lib/ file of its own name — it bundles StageBreakdownRow, PaceIndicator, OverallStatsCard and HierarchyProgressCard tests into one generic file. OverallStatsCard already has a correctly-mirrored overall_stats_card_i18n_test.dart, but pace_indicator.dart, stage_breakdown_row.dart and hierarchy_progress_card.dart have no dedicated test at their mirrored path, so locating a widget's tests by its natural mirrored path fails for those three.
finding.recommendation: Split progress_widgets_test.dart into pace_indicator_test.dart, stage_breakdown_row_test.dart and hierarchy_progress_card_test.dart at their mirrored paths.
acceptance_criteria: pace_indicator.dart, stage_breakdown_row.dart and hierarchy_progress_card.dart each have a test file at their mirrored test/ path
AG-5 mirroring checker (once it exists) passes for these three files

finding.title: Replace hand-rolled ==/hashCode on RecentActivityWindow with @freezed or a record

evidence.quote:
bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is RecentActivityWindow &&

finding.why: Standards mandate immutable @freezed classes with generated equality, never hand-written ==/hashCode. RecentActivityWindow hand-writes both. Its sibling family-key type in the very same feature, lifetimeDataProvider's `({int profileId, CurriculumId curriculumId})` record (lifetime_knowledge_providers.dart:148-151), gets structural equality for free and cannot drift out of sync — RecentActivityWindow's hand-rolled version would silently under-compare (stale FutureProvider.family cache hits) if a field were ever added to the class but forgotten in operator==.
finding.recommendation: Convert RecentActivityWindow to @freezed, or to a record matching the lifetimeDataProvider sibling's pattern.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a field to the type cannot silently break FutureProvider.family memoization

finding.title: Fix the stale 'fr-FR test below' comment in siyumim_timeline_month_key_ts13_test.dart

evidence.quote: // rely on the fr-FR test below to catch the regression.

finding.why: The file's 3 tests are all pinned to en_US / default locale; no fr-FR or any other non-English-locale test exists anywhere in the file. The comment claims a locale-switch test 'below' catches the TS-13 regression, but the actual detection comes from test 2's format-string comparison (abbreviated 'Jan 2026' vs the old hardcoded 'January 2026'), not a locale switch. A reader trusting the comment would wrongly believe the DateFormat.yMMM(locale) fix is verified against an actual non-English locale (e.g. Hebrew), when it is not — only date-format granularity is tested.
finding.recommendation: Either add the promised non-English-locale test (Locale('he') or Locale('fr')) or delete the stale comment so it stops overstating coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Comment matches actual test content, or a real non-English-locale test is added and asserts a locale-specific month header
